messages:
marie: Quick async standup — canary rollout update. Started at 09:12 UTC at 2% -> bumped to 10% at 09:45. What I did: verified rollback path + smoke scripts. Blockers: EU feature-flag cache not invalidating (seeing old config). Today: pausing at 10% and running targeted smoke + log sampling. Snippet we used to bump: 
```bash
redwoodctl rollout set-slice --slice canary-2026-03 --percent 10 --model infer-v2
```
Please drop any observations or if you see error spikes.
messages_2:
raj: Perf notes: p50 stable, p95 +40ms, p99 +120ms on embed-heavy traffic since the bump. Error rate for reranking calls up ~0.3% (baseline ~0.05%). Dashboard: https://dash.redwood.internal/d/AB12/canary?orgId=1 :point_up:
I flagged the top traces — look like timeouts around the backend reranker. Will correlate with the KV cache hit rates.
messages_3:
omar: I can confirm EU flag cache TTL sits at 5m on the edge layer. Some edge nodes haven't pulled the new flag. Suggest running an invalidation: 
```bash
curl -X POST \
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer $EDGE_TOKEN' \
  https://edge.internal/flags/invalidate?region=eu
```
I'll queue that now.
messages_4:
louisa: Oncall note — I'm seeing a small uptick in 5xx for slice=canary-2026-03 across eu-west-1. If error rate > 0.5% sustained for 10m we should rollback to 2%. Prepared rollback command: 
```bash
redwoodctl rollout set-slice --slice canary-2026-03 --percent 2 --reason "auto rollback threshold hit"
```
I'll monitor alerts and tag the SRE rotation.
messages_5: raj: I'll open a tiny PR to increase the reranker timeout from 5s -> 8s to reduce transient errors (should be low-risk). Pinging @simone for a quick review, will include the trace IDs.
messages_6: simone: On it — can review in ~15m. If you can paste the trace IDs here I'll prioritize the traces showing the timeout path.
messages_7: deploy-bot: [deploy] canary-slice update applied by marie — 10% target reached. CI: green. Monitoring checks: smoke tests started.
messages_8: marie: Pausing ramp at 10% while we validate. Running log-sample + user-session replay for the next 20m. If all good, next bump to 25% at ~10:15 UTC. Thanks for the quick responses :thumbsup:
messages_9: omar: Edge invalidation done. EU nodes show new flag propagation within ~45s. Re-checking KV cache hit rates now.
messages_10: louisa: I'll keep alerts on and report back if we cross thresholds. If anyone needs a rollback, call me in #eng-oncall and I'll execute the command.
messages_11: raj: PR opened: github.com/redwood/repo/pull/482 — timeout bump + small retry tweak. @simone please add the r+ when green.
messages_12: simone: Reviewed, left one tiny nit about a test assertion. Will approve after that fix.
